definitions.short: Manachath , the name of an Edomite and of a place in Moab
definitions.full: H4506. Manachath I. [ מָנַ֫חַת ] proper name, of a location (= resting-place, settlement ), מָנָ֑חַת 1Chr 8:6 , site unknown, ᵐ5 Μαχαναθει , ᵐ5 L Μανουαθ . II. מָנַ֫חַת proper name, masculine in Edom Gen 36:23 = 1Chr 1:40 ; ᵐ5 Μαν ( ν ) αχαθ , Μανααθ .
